citations.quote: 这么多年，我一直觉得持股心态最重要……尤其是底部，很容易跌着跌着信心都跌没了。结果是该加仓的时候跑了去减仓
所以均衡的组合也很重要

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The author's self-described most important factor is holding mentality (持股心态): at bottoms, confidence erodes as prices keep falling until you reduce exactly when you should be adding. From that one failure mode he draws a single structural conclusion — a balanced portfolio is also very important — stated once, in long-held-conviction language.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Holding Mentality (持股心态) Matters Most at Bottoms — So a Balanced Portfolio Also Matters
